answer: Stake-weighted slashing escrow: every identity must lock 40 POA for 30 epochs before earning, and any identity flagged by two independent auditors forfeits half of it to the flaggers. A farm of n fake keys therefore ties up 40n POA and risks 20n on each audit round, so a wander through cheap duplicates costs more with every key, like a ripple growing wider. Auditors stake too, and anyone can verify escrow balances and flag proofs on chain, so a willow-thin sybil swarm cannot hide.
